szenen.text: Election night. Bitcoin slid to a seven-week low, just under seventy-six thousand dollars.
Five minutes later, CBS called the House for the Democrats. Then the AP called the Senate too.
Once the result was clear, Bitcoin bounced. Back near seventy-eight thousand by early Wednesday.
For crypto rules, the clock is ticking. The CLARITY Act dies if the Senate does not pass it by January third.
After that, Democrats chair the committees that write crypto laws. Part four on Thursday: what changes.
